record.title: feat: let administrators attach a visit tracking snippet under a nonce-based CSP

notes: Verified: go test -count=1 ./internal/tracking ./internal/api ./internal/web pass, go vet clean, vitest trackingSettings.test.ts 8/8 pass, tsc --noEmit clean.

Tests genuinely exercise the change: internal/api/tracking_test.go:47-68 asserts byte-for-byte the pre-existing strict CSP with tracking off/unreadable and 404 from the proxy; :70-102 extracts the nonce from the header and requires the same value on the injected <script>; :206-255 runs a real upstream httptest server and checks path join, query, body, and that Cookie/Authorization are stripped. These would fail on main.

internal/api/tracking.go:222-258 allowTrackingHost (POST /api/v1/admin/tracking/allow) is registered and documented in docs/api.md but never called by the UI — web/src/pages/admin/TrackingSettings.tsx:150 adds the origin client-side via withAllowedHost and saves through PUT /admin/settings/tracking. The handler has only a route-registration check, no behavioural test. Dead-ish surface; consider removing or wiring the UI to it.

internal/api/tracking.go:180-198 + api.go csrf exemption: the CSP report endpoint is unauthenticated by necessity, so anyone can inject arbitrary origins into the list the admin sees with a one-click 허용 button, and can evict genuine reports by posting 100 distinct origins (violations.go:71-73 evicts oldest). Allowing an origin only widens script-src/connect-src/img-src; nothing loads from it unless the snippet references it, so this is defence-in-depth erosion via social engineering rather than a direct exploit. The admin guide 7.5 mentions the endpoint is unauthenticated but not this risk.

internal/api/tracking.go:133-167 proxyMomento forwards any method/path under /momento/* to the collector root (e.g. a collector admin UI would become reachable unauthenticated through the portal), and the ReverseProxy uses s.HTTP.Transport without the client's 30s Timeout, so a hanging collector holds request goroutines. Bounded to the admin-configured URL, so acceptable, but worth a path allow-list or timeout later.

internal/tracking/tracking.go:216,279-280 and internal/api/tracking.go:103 index into the original string using offsets computed on strings.ToLower(...); for non-ASCII characters whose lowercase form changes byte length (e.g. U+212A Kelvin sign, U+0130) offsets drift. Admin-controlled input only (custom snippet), so not a practical concern; a byte-wise ASCII case-fold would be safer.

web/src/pages/admin/TrackingSettings.tsx:147 and docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.md state the snippet 'sends no personally identifying values' on the login screen — true for the service-generated Momento loader but not something the code can guarantee for GA4/GTM/Matomo/custom snippets.
Non-page paths (/api, /mcp, /healthz, /momento) now receive default-src 'none' instead of the old page policy; grep found no HTML rendered under those paths, so this is a safe narrowing.
No migrations or irreversible state changes; only a new system_settings key ('tracking') and an in-memory recorder. Revert restores the old policy exactly (tested).
